headline: Bunge Global (BG) Leans on Viterra Synergies and Buybacks Is Its Capital Strategy Evolving?
summary: Bunge Global SA recently reported past second-quarter 2026 results, with sales rising to US$24,041 million and net income to US$678 million, alongside higher earnings per share from continuing operations year on year. At the same time, the company continued executing on its long-running US$2.70 billion buyback program linked to the Viterra combination, signaling confidence in the benefits of integration and capital returns.
